# MICRO - Mold Career

> > MICRO provides comprehensive mold inspector certification, training courses, and professional inspection equipment for career advancement in the mold remediation industry.

MICRO (moldcareer.com) is a specialized platform offering certified mold inspector (CMI) and certified mold remediation contractor (CMRC) training programs, OSHA-compliant safety courses, and a curated store of professional-grade inspection equipment from brands like Extech, Flir, and Fluke. The platform serves professionals seeking career development and compliance in mold inspection and remediation.

## Key Topics

- Mold Inspector Certification (CMI)
- Mold Remediation Contractor (CMRC)
- OSHA Safety Training
- Indoor Air Quality Monitoring
- Mold Inspection Tools
- Environmental Monitoring
- Inspection Equipment
- Professional Development
- Mold Remediation
- Certification Programs
- State Mold Legislation
- Professional Ethics
- E-learning Courses
- Equipment Dataloggers

## Certification & Training Programs

- [Mold Training Certification Programs](https://www.moldcareer.com/training-certification): MICRO's main training catalog including CMI and CMRC certifications
- [Safety Courses](https://www.moldcareer.com/training-certification/62/Safety-Courses): OSHA-compliant safety training courses and certification programs
- [The Key Benefits of MICRO Training Program Online](https://www.moldcareer.com/benefits-of-micro-training): Guide highlighting benefits of MICRO online training programs
- [MICRO Course Reviews](https://www.moldcareer.com/reviews): Student testimonials and reviews for CMI and CMRC courses

## Inspection Equipment & Tools Store

- [MICRO Store](https://www.moldcareer.com/store): MICRO equipment and tools store for mold inspection and remediation
- [AirFlow Meters](https://www.moldcareer.com/store/1/59): Anemometer and airflow measurement tools for mold inspection
- [Borescopes & Inspection Cameras](https://www.moldcareer.com/store/1/96): Borescopes and inspection cameras for visual mold assessment
- [Dataloggers](https://www.moldcareer.com/store/1/53): Environmental monitoring dataloggers for indoor air quality assessment
- [Clamp Meters](https://www.moldcareer.com/store/1/136): Electrical testing clamp meters for HVAC and safety diagnostics
- [Combustion Analyzers & Meters](https://www.moldcareer.com/store/1/134): Combustion analysis tools for HVAC safety and efficiency testing
- [Cable Length Meter](https://www.moldcareer.com/store/1/163): Cable length measurement tools for inspection and testing
